verdict.rationale: Persona's API/webhooks expose structured, machine-readable verification data: real-time status updates (approved/declined/review) via webhooks and polling, verification-specific answers (e.g., 'does the ID support identity claim', 'is individual present'), and dedicated risk reports (Watchlist, PEP, Adverse Media) that agents could parse to branch decisions, plus Workflows for automating decisioning logic based on these signals. Missing for 10: explicit JSON schema/examples of failure-reason codes or risk-signal payload structure, and any independent/hands-on confirmation that agents actually consume these fields programmatically for branching logic.
